entity: Grain Processing Corp's Muscatine, Iowa corn mill: repeated air violations with almost no state enforcement
what_we_add: 49 failed-test days 2015-25 (#1 of 29 wet corn mills), 0 Iowa orders vs 7 Indiana orders at the twin plant, Iowa 19 vs Indiana 572 statewide
why: Center for Public Integrity names GPC Muscatine and states the same finding in words: dozens of air violations, penalties only twice. Its decade is 2001-2011, so every 2015-25 count and the Iowa-Indiana comparison is ours alone.
